Emily J. Rodriguez  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972 52 123 4567 | emily.rodriguez@email.com | linkedin.com/in/emilyrodriguez  

**Summary**  
Seasoned data scientist with 14 years of experience driving scalable analytics solutions in fintech. Specialized in building production-grade machine learning systems, optimizing data pipelines, and mentoring cross-functional teams. Proven track record in improving risk modeling accuracy, reducing operational costs, and enhancing decision-making through data-driven insights.

- Built time series forecasting models for market volatility prediction, achieving a 15% improvement in forecast accuracy compared to legacy systems.  
- Mentored 3 junior data scientists, guiding them through end-to-end project cycles from data pipeline design to production deployment.

*2008 – 2012*

- **MLOps (MLflow)**: Implemented CI/CD for model deployment, cutting deployment cycles from 14 to 3 days.  
- **Time Series Analysis**: Developed volatility forecasts with 15% higher accuracy than legacy models.
